id.description: Unique slug identifying the endpoint: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 40 characters.
id.title: Id

enabled.description: A disabled endpoint is kept but not served.
enabled.title: Enabled

min_cvss.description: Minimum CVSS score, 0 to 10; omit for no threshold.
min_cvss.title: Min Cvss

kev_only.description: Only vulnerabilities known to be exploited (CISA KEV).
kev_only.title: Kev Only

require_score.description: Drop vulnerabilities that no source has scored yet, except known-exploited ones (CISA KEV or EU KEV).
require_score.title: Require Score

token.description: Secret that gives access to the feed, unique across endpoints: 32 to 128 URL-safe characters (A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -).
token.title: Token

products.description: Products to watch: a shorthand string or a full entry. Names must be unique within the endpoint (case-insensitive). An endpoint without products matches nothing.

oneOf.description: Shorthand product: "<name>" or "<name> >= <minimum version>", for example "php >= 8.2".

products.title: Products

name.description: Product name, matched as a whole word, or as a whole name when `exact` is true.
name.title: Name

aliases.description: Other names the same product goes by.
aliases.title: Aliases

exclude.description: Terms that rule this entry out when they appear in the affected products or in the description.
exclude.title: Exclude

min_version.description: Minimum version of interest, as a quoted string (YAML reads 8.10 as the number 8.1).
min_version.title: Min Version

match_description.description: Search the description when a vulnerability lists no affected product; false matches on affected-product data only.
match_description.title: Match Description

exact.description: Match only an affected product whose whole name equals the name or an alias (case-insensitive); vendor names and the description are never used for matching. Cannot be combined with match_description: true.
exact.title: Exact

endpoints.description: The endpoints, each with its own feed.
endpoints.title: Endpoints
